priorityList: Use Mind Freeze to interrupt spellcasting.
Cast Reaper's Mark when Pillar of Frost is nearly ready (within 1 GCD) and you have sufficient Runic Power.
Cast Pillar of Frost on cooldown, ensuring Reaper's Mark has been applied first if available.
Activate Breath of Sindragosa while Pillar of Frost is active and you have at least 60 Runic Power.
Maintain Remorseless Winter at all times in AoE combat.
Cast Frostwyrm's Fury during Pillar of Frost or Breath of Sindragosa, but only if Reaper's Mark and Exterminate are not active.
Cast Frostscythe when Killing Machine is active if there are 3 or more targets present.
Cast Obliterate when Killing Machine is active if there are fewer than 3 targets or to spend Killing Machine stacks.
Cast Howling Blast when Rime is active or if Frost Fever is not ticking on your targets.
Cast Frost Strike on targets with 5 stacks of Razorice if Shattering Blade is talented.
Cast Glacial Advance to spend Runic Power in AoE scenarios.
Use Empower Rune Weapon if you have fewer than 2 Runes or if you need to generate Killing Machine procs during Pillar of Frost.
Pool at least 3 Runes if Reaper's Mark is coming off cooldown in less than 6 seconds.
Use offensive Trinkets and Racials during your Pillar of Frost window.
